name: core-constants
description: Constants, the core's fields set at create (D16, amended): an update that changes a listed field is invalid_instance with the rule constant at the field, a caller's update and an operation's update() alike, unless the caller holds the config's permission; a field the create leaves absent stays absent; absent and null are one; validateUpdate() reports it, which Revisions' propose asks; the config names the type's own fields, and any change to it is allowed, the behavior's adding and removing included.

shared.s7: Types an open JSON field of the type by the value of another of its fields: while by holds a value types lists, field, when it holds a value, is held to that type of the schema document as a field of the type is, unknown keys refused at every depth; while by holds another value or none, field holds none. A result whose shape differs per kind of step is refused when it is written in the wrong shape. The describe document and the create and update tools show each variant.

operations.name: create
operations.title: Create Step
operations.description: Creates a Step: validates the instance, data, against the schema's live version and stores it under id, or under a new id when none is given.

allOf.description: While kind is "review", result is a ReviewResult
While kind is "verify", result is a VerifyResult
While kind holds another value or none, result holds none

result.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

id.description: The instance id; the engine makes one when it is absent

guidance.useWhen: Use to create a new Step: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one. Give kind at create: it does not change after it, and one left absent stays absent. Give result the shape kind picks: result holds ReviewResult when kind is review or VerifyResult when kind is verify, and nothing while kind holds another value or none.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
guidance.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

operations.name: get
operations.title: Get Step
operations.description: Returns the Step with the id: its own fields in data, its behaviors' in behaviors.

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

guidance.useWhen: Use when you have the id of the Step to read.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to find Step instances; call list.
guidance.success: Returns the instance with its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

operations.name: list
operations.title: List Step
operations.description: Lists Step instances in creation order, a page at a time: pass a page's next as cursor for the page after it. where keeps the instances whose fields hold the values it gives, a list meaning any of them; a filtered page can hold fewer than limit while next is not null.

limit.description: How many instances a page holds, 50 when absent

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

where.description: The values the instances hold, by field: a value, null for none, or a list of 1 to 100 meaning any of them; every member must hold

next.description: The next page's cursor; null after the last page

guidance.useWhen: Use to page through Step instances, oldest first. where keeps the ones whose fields hold the values it gives, null meaning no value and a list of values any of them: title or kind; a behavior's field by its qualified name, the behavior's, a dot and the field's.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read one instance whose id you have; call get.
guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null. With where, a page can hold fewer items than limit, even none, while next is not null: read on until it is.

operations.name: update
operations.title: Update Step
operations.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) to the Step with the id: a member replaces the instance's, a nested object merges and null removes a member. With expectedSeq the update is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

allOf.description: While kind is "review", result is a ReviewResult
While kind is "verify", result is a VerifyResult
While kind holds another value or none, result holds none

patch.description: A JSON merge patch of the Step

result.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

guidance.useWhen: Use to change the own fields of the Step with the id, as a JSON merge patch; with expectedSeq, the update is refused if the instance changed since that seq. A patch of result keeps the shape kind picks, as merged; the describe document shows each shape under allOf.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to set a behavior's field: the patch holds own fields only, and a behavior's fields change only through its operations. Do not change kind: a change is refused as invalid_instance, with rule constant at the field.
guidance.success: Returns the instance as the patch left it, with its next seq.

operations.name: delete
operations.title: Delete Step
operations.description: Deletes the Step with the id. With expectedSeq the delete is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

guidance.useWhen: Use to delete the Step with the id for good; with expectedSeq, the delete is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
guidance.success: Returns null; the instance and what its behaviors kept for it are gone.

declaration.name: Constants
declaration.description: Fields of the type that its create sets and nothing changes after: an update that changes one, a caller's or one a behavior's operation applies, is refused at the field, unless the caller holds the config's permission. A field the create leaves absent stays absent. What routes an instance, such as a step's kind or the key a blueprint stamped it with, stays what its create gave it.

fields.description: The type's own top-level fields, by JSON key, that keep the value their create gives them.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to change them after the create; nobody may when absent.

by.description: The type's own string or enum field, by JSON key, whose value picks the type.

field.description: The type's own field the variants type, by JSON key: a Generic.JSON field, or one of a scalar whose values are JSON objects.

types.description: By a value of by, the type of the schema document, besides the instance type, that field holds while by holds the value.
